title: Why You Hear Your Name in a Crowd
text:
Psychologists call it the cocktail party effect. In Neville Moray's 1959 experiment, about a third of people noticed their own name in a message they were told to ignore.

Follow for one brain fact a day.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cocktail_party_effect
Source: https://doi.org/10.1080/17470215908416289
